📖 How to use

  1. Press “Start” — ←/→ rotate, ↑ thrust, Space shoots.
  2. Blast asteroids; big ones split into smaller ones.
  3. Avoid collisions — you have 3 lives with brief shields after each hit.
  4. Clear the field to level up.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I control the ship?

←/→ rotate, ↑ thrust, Space fires. On touch screens use the on-screen buttons.

What happens when I shoot an asteroid?

Big asteroids split into two medium ones, mediums split into two small ones. Big = 20, medium = 50, small = 100 points.

How do levels work?

Clear every asteroid to advance a level — each level adds more, faster asteroids.
